text: {"lessons":["Buying equal amounts of all five stocks at once left my portfolio exposed to broad market moves; I should diversify deliberately and avoid investing a large portion of cash without a plan.","Selling Stock C after a gain and Stock D after a loss did not follow a consistent rule; I should decide in advance what would justify selling each holding.","Adding to Stocks B and E after their prices rose increased my exposure; before adding, I should check whether the investment still fits my target allocation and long-term apartment goal."]}
